```yaml
name: Update Lint Config
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-lint-config:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: 'go.mod'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          go install github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/cmd/golangci-lint@latest

      - name: Download latest lint config
        run: |
          curl -o .golangci.yml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gruntwork-io/terragrunt/master/.golangci.yml

      - name: Check for changes
        id: git-check
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code .golangci.yml || echo "changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.git-check.outputs.changed == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: update lint config from upstream"
          title: "chore: update lint config from upstream"
          body: "This PR updates the lint configuration from the upstream terragrunt repository. This is an automated update triggered by the weekly cron job."
          branch: update-lint-config-weekly
          base: main
```
